title: Declare which soft recipe fields may evolve under optimization
narrative: Hard nodes and trusted contracts must never be silently rewritten by an optimizer; only allowlisted soft parameters (prompts, lane selection, bounded retries, thresholds) may evolve. Soft points already exist (`fangore_graph_template_soft_points`, `fangore_insp_soft_vs_hard`). Tracks MH-SR-03[^insp-sr-03].
implementation: SoftPoint contracts and soft-vs-hard grants. Desired: explicit evolution allowlist tagging soft fields vs hard-immutable structure.
validation: Kind `inspiration_delta_contract`. Soft expects requirement_id MH-SR-03, coverage partial, adjacent_ok true.
